strategy_catalog.name: Targeted SetWaitFlag - Anti Patterns
strategy_catalog.natural_language: Replace all PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> with targeted SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> calls. PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> drains all pipeline channels, destroying overlap. Targeted barriers only wait for the specific dependency needed.

anti_patterns.pattern: Use PipeBarrier<PIPE_ALL> for every synchronization point
anti_patterns.reason: Drains all pipeline channels (V, M, MTE1, MTE2, MTE3, FIX), destroying overlap
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use SetWaitFlag<HardEvent::X_Y> for specific dependency only

anti_patterns.reason: set/wait synchronization mismatch causes state residue, affecting subsequent operators
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Always pair SetFlag and WaitFlag for the same HardEvent

anti_patterns.reason: Counter limit is 15, exceeding causes deadlock without reverse sync
anti_patterns.correct_approach: Use bidirectional sync or reset counter after 15 uses

precautions: Ensure SetFlag and WaitFlag are paired for each HardEvent
Verify pipeline overlap improvement with profiling tools
Test with mssanitizer to detect sync mismatch early
